title.value: Cortico-Cerebellar neurodynamics during social interaction in Autism Spectrum Disorders
title.justification: The paper focuses on the neurodynamics of social interaction within Autism Spectrum Disorders.
title.quote: Cortico-Cerebellar neurodynamics during social interaction in Autism Spectrum Disorders

extractions.description: This paper investigates the cortico-cerebellar neurodynamics in individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorders (ASD) during social interactions. Using high-density electroencephalography (HD-EEG) and the Human Dynamic Clamp (HDC) paradigm, the study measures theta oscillations and connectivity between the cerebellum and cerebral cortices in ASD and typically developing (TD) individuals. Results indicate increased theta power and coherence in ASD participants during interactions, highlighting possible neural biomarkers for ASD.
